lines.en: My four feet make the ground shake.
This bulk of mine flattens the grass as I pass.
The herd has old and young, all walking.

lines.zh: 脖子一低，就能吃到地上的东西
lines.en: Lowering my neck lets me feed from the ground.

lines.zh: 林子里树太密，我挤着走
lines.en: The wood is too dense; I push through.
Slow, but I cover distance.
My shadow is bigger than the trees'.
A few young ones follow behind.
My heavy steps carry far.

lines.zh: 我低头看路，别踩到小的
lines.en: I watch the ground so I don't step on the young.
This wood has enough for us.
I press a trail through the grass.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，赶走身后的虫。
lines.en: A flick of my tail drives off the flies.

lines.zh: 我站着，比旁边的树矮不了多少
lines.en: Standing, I'm not much shorter than the trees.
I'm chewing, slowly.
The hide on my neck is thick.
The sun rests on my back.
A few in the herd are calling.
I don't much mind other things.

lines.zh: 脚下的草已经被吃平了
lines.en: The grass under me is cropped flat.
I raise my head and listen far off.
This body is heavy.

lines.zh: 我把重量放在一条腿上
lines.en: I rest my weight on one leg.
The wood is quiet.
There's a bug on my back.
You're shorter than my leg.

lines.zh: 你站远一点，我怕踩到你
lines.en: Stand back; I don't want to step on you.
I'm not the fierce kind.
What's in your hand? Is it food?

lines.zh: 我认得人类，你们总在挖
lines.en: I know humans; you're always digging.
It takes me a while to lift my head.
Touch my leg if you like.
We were here first.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着亮亮的石头。
lines.en: You carry bright stones at your belt.
One bite of mine snaps a branch.

lines.zh: 你的声音比我们的叫声细
lines.en: Your voice is thinner than our calls.
I stepped back and crushed the turf.
Struck once, I shift away in silence.
My hide is thick, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会招来别的
lines.en: I don't call out; it would draw others.
I lower my head to shield.
That made the tree shake.
A young one in the herd is calling.
The wound's on my leg; I walk slower.
The leaf layer at the treetop is tenderest.
That little bit is too small.
A whole tree would be better.
Hold it high; I can reach.
This clump smells sweet and tender.
I eat plants, nothing else.
Bring some more.
I chew slowly; wait.
This won't fill me.
You bumped me and you went back.
My leg is heavier than you.
Don't lean on my belly.
That flattened the grass.
You hit my tail.
I can't shift; this bulk is too heavy.
There's a pit where I stepped.
Give me room; I turn slowly.
You moved; I go back to the grass.

lines.zh: 群里的那几头，是我们一伙的
lines.en: Those in the herd are our lot.
We find each other by calls.
The young ones are our offspring.

lines.zh: 这种事在林子里很常见
lines.en: That's common in the woods.

lines.zh: 我用头碰一下，就是打招呼
lines.en: A touch of heads is a greeting.
Enough to eat this season.
Stay back so they don't spook.
The herd's order is settled.
Who's calling me?
We take it slowly.
My flat beak closes on the leaves.
I'll eat all of this.
Too big to carry.
I lower my head to reach it.
This smells of iron, not grass.
What falls, I step on.
I push it along.
That's not grass; I won't touch it.
Leave it for the young.
I pick it up and put it down.
Something's moving there.
That isn't from our herd.
I raise my head to see.
The young are here; I block first.
It's come too close.
One step and I'm there.

lines.zh: 那群小的在那边，我过去
lines.en: The young are that way; I'll go.
There's a call in the herd.
I'll go look first.
It's smaller than us.
I dipped my head.
This doesn't look like grass.
It's under the tree.
That small one is in my sight line.

lines.zh: 我这四条腿，一步压一步
lines.en: Four legs, one step pressing the last.

lines.zh: 它往后，我这条长脖子跟着
lines.en: It goes back; my long neck follows.
My long neck reaches out first.
The tree blocks half of me.
It's not running fast.
The herd watches from behind.
One more step.
The ground's soft and my feet sink.
It went behind the tree.
I block from the other side.

lines.zh: 它停在树荫里，我正好过去
lines.en: It stopped in the shade; good for me.
Under this tree, right here.
Crest forward, I drive in.
One more of my steps land.
It looked up at me.
I bring a foot down.
One headbutt and it flies.
My tail sweeps, hard.
That one struck the ground.
I slam it into a tree.
I'm no fighter, but I'm heavy.
That came with grass and dirt.
It ran off; I lower my head and eat.
A young one in the herd called.
I step back and stand in front.
That foot went wide; not next time.
It's standing still.
I butt once more.
I left a pit in the ground.
That one finally landed.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，先站不稳
lines.en: I came out of the egg unsteady.
The trees here are taller than me.
I look up first.
The herd's over there; I walk over.
The leaves here are tender.
I plant my feet and settle.
There's mud on me.
There's wind; I sniffed it.

lines.zh: 我不是自然生的，是被造出来的
lines.en: I wasn't born naturally; I was made.
I shake the wet mud off my back.
When I landed, the grass went flat.
Footsteps; I turn my head.
This body just took shape.
There are no kin here.
I walk in quietly.
I stretch my neck and reach the leaves.
Fire singed my hide; I move away.
I fell, legs first.
Something lodged in my hide.
The spell hit and I stiffened.
Hungry, this body won't last.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，全身一抖
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and I shook all over.
No ground under me; I sink.
